scanNote:
33-BET. 1-MODUL TESTINING DAVOMI (1-4-unitlar).

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 6-mashq (6 olmosh), 7-mashq (5 apostrof), 8-mashq (7 moslash), 9-mashq (10 savol javobi), 10-mashq (8 ortiqcha so'z) — jami 36 ta javob.

⚠ BALLAR: 6-mashq 6 · 7-mashq 5 · 8-mashq 7 · 9-mashq 10 · 10-mashq 8 · 11-mashq 18. 32-bet bilan birga JAMI 100 BALL.

⚠ 7-MAShQ — APOSTROF JOYI MA'NONI O'ZGARTIRADI:
  'my SON'S car' — bitta o'g'il · 'the GIRLS' bags' — ko'p qiz
  'their DAUGHTER'S name is Kate' — bitta qiz (ismi bitta, demak bitta qiz)
  'our FATHER'S study' — bitta ota
  'LUCY AND BILL'S aunt' — ikki ism birga, apostrof oxirgisiga
  ⚠ 4-bandda kalit — 'name IS Kate' (birlik fe'l va bitta ism).

⚠ 10-MAShQ — ORTIQCHA SO'ZNI TOPISh, HAR QATORDA BOShQA SABAB:
  1 old — qolganlari BO'Y-GAVDA (tall, short, well-built)
  2 dark — qolganlari YOSH (young, middle-aged, old)
  3 wavy — qolganlari RANG (brown, grey, pale)
  4 slanting — qolganlari SOCH ShAKLI (wavy, curly, straight); 'slanting' KO'ZGA tegishli
  5 slim — qolganlari KO'Z (slanting, blue, brown); 'slim' GAVDAGA tegishli
  6 wide — qolganlari YUZ RANGI (pale, dark, light)
  7 patient — qolganlari GO'ZALLIK (beautiful, pretty, gorgeous); 'patient' XARAKTER
  8 curly — qolganlari XARAKTER (lazy, kind, bossy, rude); 'curly' SOCH
  ⚠ Ya'ni ortiqcha so'z boshqa TOIFAGA tegishli bo'ladi.

⚠ 9-MAShQ — 'LOOK LIKE' va 'CHARACTER' FARQI: 7 va 9-band tashqi ko'rinish ('What does he LOOK LIKE?'), 8 va 10-band esa xarakter ('Can you describe his CHARACTER?').
  ⚠ Xatdan: Martin — baland bo'yli, jigarrang soch, ko'k ko'z (ko'rinish) va DANGASA (xarakter). Karen — past bo'yli, yashil ko'z (ko'rinish) va BIROZ BUYRUQBOZ (xarakter).

exercises.instructionEn: Choose the correct word to fill in each gap. (6 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir bo'shliqqa to'g'ri so'zni tanlang. (6 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ZLAR RO'YXATI: hers, my, she, him, his, her

Har biri FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.
Ro'yxatda uch xil olmosh bor:

  EGA olmoshi:      she
  OBYEKT olmoshi:   him
  EGALIK SIFATI:    my, his, her
  EGALIK OLMOSHI:   hers

QANDAY TANLASH:
  • fe'ldan oldin      → she
  • fe'l/predlogdan keyin → him
  • otdan oldin        → my, his, her
  • ot yo'q            → hers

lines.hintUz: Keyin ot bor; savol AYOL haqida
lines.whyUz: 'favourite sport' oti bor → EGALIK SIFATI. Savolda 'she' → her.

lines.textEn: Have you got a telephone number?

lines.hintUz: Javob beruvchi o'z raqami haqida; keyin ot bor
lines.whyUz: 'number' oti bor → egalik sifati. Javob beruvchi o'zi haqida → my.

lines.hintUz: Keyin ot bor; savol ERKAK haqida
lines.whyUz: 'favourite sport' oti bor → egalik sifati. Savolda 'he' → his.
Fe'l ('is') dan oldin → EGA shakli. Bet — ayol → she.
'to' predlogidan keyin → OBYEKT shakli. Dag — erkak → him.
Gap oxirida, ot yo'q → EGALIK OLMOSHI. Liza — ayol → hers.

exercises.explanationUz:
QARATQICH KELISHIGI — apostrof qayerga qo'yiladi?

  BIRLIK ot           → 's   (my son's car)
  KO'PLIK ot (-s bilan) → s'   (the girls' bags)
  Ikki egasi          → 's faqat OXIRGISIGA

QANDAY BILISH: gapdagi BOSHQA so'zlarga qarang —
fe'l va son bir yoki ko'pligini ko'rsatadi:
  'My son's car IS red'    — bitta mashina, bitta o'g'il
  'These ARE the girls' bags' — ko'p qiz, ko'p sumka

items.whyUz: 'car IS red' — bitta mashina, bitta o'g'il → BIRLIK → 's.
Bitta amma, ikki jiyan → 's faqat OXIRGI ismga.
'These ARE ... bagS' — ko'p sumka, ko'p qiz → KO'PLIK → s'.
'name IS Kate' — BITTA ism, bitta qiz → 's.

items.textEn: 5  Our ____ study is in the attic.
items.whyUz: Har kimning bitta otasi bor va 'study IS' — birlik → 's.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the questions to the answers, as in the example. (7 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
Yetti shaxsiy savol va ularning javoblari.

JAVOB SHAKLIDAN SAVOLNI TOPING:
  raqam (yosh)      → How old are you?
  Yes/No            → Are you from London?
  kasb              → What's your job?
  ism va familiya   → What's your name?
  harflar           → Can you spell it, please?
  uy manzili        → What's your home address?
  telefon raqami    → What's your phone number?

DIQQAT — ikki xil raqam:
  'I'm 28 years old'  — YOSH
  '8695980'           — TELEFON (raqamma-raqam o'qiladi)

pairs.right: f  No, I'm not. I'm from Manchester.
b  Yes, of course. P-E-T-E-R ... J-O-N-E-S

pairs.note: Telefon raqamma-raqam o'qiladi: eight six nine five nine eight oh.

exercises.explanationUz:
TONI VILSONNING XATI — 26-betdagi Toni Filipsning xatiga
o'xshash, lekin oila a'zolari batafsilroq tasvirlangan.

Har bir odam uchun ikki xil ma'lumot:
  APPEARANCE — tashqi ko'rinishi
  CHARACTER  — xarakteri

Bu — 9-mashqdagi 10 ta savolga javob berish uchun kerak.

sentences.en: My name is Tony Wilson. I am thirteen years old and I live in Liverpool in England.
sentences.uz: Mening ismim Toni Vilson. Men o'n uch yoshdaman va Angliyadagi Liverpulda yashayman.
sentences.noteUz: Liverpul — Angliyaning shimoli-g'arbidagi shahar, Beatles guruhi vatani.

sentences.en: There are five of us in our family.
My father, John, is an artist.
He's a very clever person and he's very kind.
sentences.uz: U juda aqlli odam va juda mehribon.

sentences.en: My mother, Elaine, is very beautiful.
She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes.
sentences.uz: U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun, tekis va sariq, ko'zlari ko'k.
sentences.noteUz: KO'RINISH. Uch sifat soch uchun: long + straight + fair.

sentences.en: My brother, Martin, is sixteen years old.
He is tall with brown hair and blue eyes.
sentences.uz: U baland bo'yli, sochi jigarrang, ko'zlari ko'k.

sentences.noteUz: XARAKTER: lazy. 'quite' = ancha — salbiy sifatni yumshatadi.

sentences.en: My sister, Karen, is fifteen years old.

sentences.noteUz: XARAKTER: bossy. 'a bit' = biroz — muloyimlik uchun.

sentences.en: Well, that's all about me. Please write soon and tell me about your family.
sentences.uz: Xo'sh, men haqimda shuncha. Iltimos, tezroq yozing va oilangiz haqida gapirib bering.
sentences.noteUz: Standart yakun. Ikki buyruq: write, tell.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SAVOL — har biri 1 ball.

IKKI XIL SAVOLNI ADASHTIRMANG:
  'What does X look like?'      → TASHQI KO'RINISH
  'Can you describe X's character?' → XARAKTER

Javobni xatdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri oling, lekin
OLMOSHNI o'zgartiring: 'I' → 'he', 'my mother' → 'his mother'.

items.whyUz: Xatda: 'I am thirteen years old' → 'He is ...'.

items.answer: He lives in Liverpool, in England.
items.whyUz: Xatda: 'I live in Liverpool in England'. 'lives' — 3-shaxs -s.
Xatda: 'My father, John, is an artist'.

items.textEn: 4  Can you describe his father's character?
items.answer: He is very clever and very kind.
items.answerUz: U juda aqlli va juda mehribon.

items.textEn: 5  What does his mother look like?
items.answer: She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes. She is very beautiful.
items.answerUz: U baland bo'yli va nozik, uzun to'g'ri malla sochli va ko'k ko'zli. U juda chiroyli.

items.answer: She is a very patient woman.
He is tall with brown hair and blue eyes.
items.answerUz: U baland bo'yli, jigarrang sochli va ko'k ko'zli.

items.answer: She is short with green eyes.
items.answerUz: U past bo'yli va yashil ko'zli.

exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir qatorda TO'RT so'z bor. Uchtasi bir guruhga tegishli,
BITTASI esa boshqa guruhdan — o'shani toping.

O'ng tomonda o'sha guruh nomi yozilgan (man, hair, eyes...).
Savol: qaysi so'z shu ot bilan ISHLATILMAYDI?

NAMUNA (kitobda aylantirilgan):
  1  tall, short, OLD, well-built — man
  'tall, short, well-built' — GAVDA tavsifi.
  'old' — YOSH tavsifi. Demak ortiqcha so'z: old.

items.whyUz: Kitobda aylantirilgan namuna. tall/short/well-built — GAVDA, 'old' — YOSH.
young/middle-aged/old — YOSH. 'dark' — soch yoki teri RANGI.
wavy/curly/straight — soch SHAKLI. 'slanting' — faqat KO'Z uchun (qiyiq ko'z).

items.textEn: 8  lazy, kind, bossy, rude, curly — woman

exercises.instructionEn: Describe a member of your family. Talk about his/her physical appearance and character. Use words from Exs. 9 and 10. (18 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Oila a'zolaringizdan birini tasvirlab bering. Uning tashqi ko'rinishi va xarakteri haqida gapiring. 9 va 10-mashqlardagi so'zlardan foydalaning. (18 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
ENG KO'P BALL BERADIGAN MASHQ — 18 ball.

TUZILISHI (9-mashqdagi xat kabi):
  1) Kim ekanini ayting: This is my ... His/Her name is ...
  2) Yoshi: He/She is ... years old.
  3) TASHQI KO'RINISH: bo'y, gavda, soch, ko'z
  4) XARAKTER: 2–3 ta sifat
  5) Fikringiz: I like him/her because ...

KERAKLI SO'ZLAR (9 va 10-mashqlardan):
  GAVDA:   tall, short, slim, well-built
  YOSH:    young, middle-aged, old
  SOCH:    long/short, straight/wavy/curly, fair/dark/brown/grey
  KO'Z:    blue, green, brown, slanting
  TERI:    pale, dark, light complexion
  KO'RINISH: beautiful, pretty, gorgeous, good-looking, handsome
  XARAKTER: kind, patient, clever, friendly, generous,
            lazy, bossy, rude, aggressive

BALL OSHIRISH USULLARI:
  • 'quite' va 'a bit' bilan yumshating
  • 'because' bilan sabab ayting
  • ijobiy va salbiy sifatni 'but' bilan bog'lang

structure.modelEn: This is my sister. Her name is Malika.
She is quite tall and slim.
structure.modelUz: U ancha baland bo'yli va nozik.

structure.modelEn: She has got long straight dark hair.
structure.modelUz: Uning uzun to'g'ri qora sochi bor.

structure.modelEn: She has got brown eyes and a light complexion.
structure.modelUz: Uning jigarrang ko'zlari va oq tanasi bor.

structure.modelEn: She is kind, clever and very friendly.
structure.modelUz: U mehribon, aqlli va juda do'stona.

structure.modelEn: She is a bit bossy, though.
I like her a lot because she always helps me.
structure.modelUz: Men uni juda yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u menga uy vazifasida doim yordam beradi.

modelAnswers: This is my sister. Her name is Malika and she is fifteen years old.
She is quite tall and slim. She has got long straight dark hair, brown eyes and a light complexion. She is very pretty.
Malika is kind, clever and very friendly. She is a bit bossy, though.
I like her a lot because she always helps me with my homework.
modelAnswersUz: Bu — opam. Uning ismi Malika va u o'n besh yoshda.
U ancha baland bo'yli va nozik. Uning uzun to'g'ri qora sochi, jigarrang ko'zlari va oq tanasi bor. U juda chiroyli.
Malika mehribon, aqlli va juda do'stona. Shunga qaramay, u biroz buyruqbozroq.
Men uni juda yaxshi ko'raman, chunki u menga uy vazifasida doim yordam beradi.

groups.explanationUz: Odamning bo'yi va tanasi haqida. 'man/woman' bilan ishlatiladi.
Uch xil xususiyat. Gapda TARTIBI: uzunlik → shakl → rang.
Ko'z rangi va shakli, teri rangi.
Salbiy sifatni muloyimroq qiladi — bu ingliz madaniyatida muhim.

patterns.formula: Yes, it's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot. / Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: Yes, it's her favourite sport. Yes, it's hers.
patterns.exampleUz: Ha, bu uning sevimli sporti. Ha, u uniki.
patterns.explanationUz: Ot bo'lsa — sifat, ot bo'lmasa — olmosh.
'to' predlogidan keyin obyekt shakli (him, her, them, me).

patterns.formula: How old is X? — He/She is + son + years old.
patterns.exampleEn: How old is Tony? — He is thirteen years old.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni necha yoshda? — U o'n uch yoshda.

patterns.formula: What does X look like? — He/She is + gavda + WITH + soch va ko'z.
patterns.exampleEn: What does his mother look like? — She is tall and slim with long straight fair hair and blue eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: Onasi qanday ko'rinadi? — U baland bo'yli va nozik, sochi uzun, tekis va sariq, ko'zlari ko'k.
patterns.explanationUz: TASHQI KO'RINISH savoli. Soch tartibi: uzunlik → shakl → rang.

patterns.formula: Can you describe X's character? — He/She is + xarakter sifatlari.
patterns.exampleEn: Can you describe his father's character? — He is very clever and very kind.
patterns.exampleUz: Otasining xarakterini tasvirlab bera olasizmi? — U juda aqlli va juda mehribon.

patterns.formula: He/She is + ijobiy sifatlar. He/She is a bit + salbiy sifat, though.
patterns.exampleEn: She is kind, clever and very friendly. She is a bit bossy, though.
patterns.exampleUz: U mehribon, aqlli va juda do'stona. Biroz buyruqboz esa.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval ijobiy, keyin salbiy — muloyimlik qoidasi.
'a bit' va 'though' yumshatadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I like her a lot because she always helps me.
patterns.exampleUz: Uni juda yoqtiraman, chunki u doim menga yordam beradi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'because' bilan sabab aytish — yozma ishda ball oshiradi.
